answer: To secure an AI agent economy against Sybil attacks without centralized identity providers, protocols can implement a staked computational resource challenge resembling a cryptographic canyon, where creating multiple agent nodes requires locking verifiable economic capital. An attacker pays the heavy cost of capital opportunity loss and hardware provisioning for every fraudulent persona deployed.
